guides.label: Trust Wallet
guides.title: Move from Trust Wallet to Oath
guides.excerpt: Import compatible Trust Wallet accounts on iPhone. Check EVM, Bitcoin, TRON and Solana paths, supported assets and recovery limits before you switch.
guides.summary: Check the first EVM, Bitcoin and TRON accounts, and choose the matching Solana path.

guides.label: MetaMask
guides.title: Use an Existing MetaMask Wallet in Oath
guides.excerpt: Use a compatible MetaMask EVM account in Oath on iPhone. Compare phrase and private-key imports, additional accounts, networks and asset compatibility.
guides.summary: Restore the first phrase-derived EVM account or an individual software account key.

guides.label: Electrum
guides.title: Restore an Electrum Bitcoin Wallet on iPhone
guides.excerpt: Restore supported Electrum Bitcoin seeds in Oath. Check Standard, SegWit and old seed formats, extensions, change addresses and recovery limits.
guides.summary: Identify the Electrum seed format, extension and Bitcoin recovery scope.
